newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bekaert plunges 15 pct on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Bekaert plunges 15 pct on profit warning.

text.p: Belgian steel cord and wire maker Bekaert plunged over 15 percent in early Brussels trade on Tuesday after the company gave a warning on 1996 earnings.
Bekaert said after the bourse closed on Monday that it expected 1996 current earnings to be cut to near break-even following a provision for a structural improvement programme.
"The situation is not good for Bekaert in Europe and the restructuring is very severe, large and sudden," analyst Geert De Mesure at broker Delen & Co told Reuters.
Bekaert shares tumbled 15.72 percent or 3,600 francs to 19,300 by 0925 GMT.
